verdict.rationale: Appwrite's database schema is the subject here, and the pack shows no database branching or isolated preview environment where an agent can test schema changes before production. The branch previews in Sites cover frontend deployments only, and the MCP server and headless CLI are general building blocks rather than this capability. Docker self-hosting and cloud/self-hosted migration are user-side workarounds and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can let an agent create and test schema changes in an isolated branch or preview environment before production
